hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Polished card-based UI with clean typography hierarchy, but the edge bundles converge into a tangled mass at the center and the circle pack is partially cropped at the bottom — the UI chrome outperforms the visualization itself.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest — scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout node sizing, key functions present in data joins, domains derived via d3.extent — minor issue is the sunburst's d3.scaleSqrt radial remapping that compresses depth proportions, but this is accepted D3 practice rather than active deception.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Easing-params sliders fire updateLayout() on every input event without debounce (line 675), launching a new 1500ms transition on each tick; layout switches also lack .interrupt() on nodeSelection/linkSelection before starting the new svg.transition(), so mid-flight clicks cause snap conflicts.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: 300 links at 8% bundle tension converge into a hairball at the center that obscures structure until hover/click interaction fades them — interaction redeems density but the default state is visually overwhelming; animation quality across 8 layout morphs cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.
